kills.property: After a failed Collect (no funds sent) followed by a Deposit of value v, the caller's recorded balance increases by v.
kills.change_summary: Remove the balance increment so Deposit no longer updates balances.

kills.property: After two deposits by the same sender, the contract's recorded balance for that sender is at least as large as the secon
kills.change_summary: Change the balance update to set balances[msg.sender] to msg.value instead of adding (resets previous balance).

kills.property: Deposit should never revert when called with a non-negative ether value (i.e., callers can always deposit funds).
kills.change_summary: Negate the require so it reverts when the usual non-overflow condition holds (require condition inverted).
